### [So you want to use OpenRouter?](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/11/so-you-want-to-use-openrouter/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-11

OpenRouter's automatic backend provider routing can cause inconsistent LLM behavior across identical requests, though users can manually restrict routing via specific API parameters.

- Different backend providers use varied serving software, optimizations, and settings for the same model endpoint.
- Inconsistencies include missing vision capability for vision models and differing implementations of the reasoning effort option.
- Routing to specific backends can be locked using the provider.only option.
- Users can query the /endpoints API method to retrieve available providers for a given model ID.

**Why it matters:** Relying on OpenRouter's automatic fallback routing risks silent, breaking inconsistencies in model behavior and feature support unless provider selection is explicitly restricted.

`openrouter` `llms` `generative-ai` `api`
